description: A fitted rust-red knee-length wool cote with narrow gold woven borders at the placket, cuffs and hem over a cream linen shirt showing at neckline and wrists. Dark brown shoulder mantle with gold leaflike woven edge fastened by a round metal brooch. Decorated brown leather belt with several metal mounts and hanging end; brown fitted trousers and tall worn brown leather boots. Both hands exposed at his sides. No headgear, armor or weapon.
